5 تعتّب عَلَيْهِ : see 1, first sentence. ―
-b2- Also He accused him of a crime, an offence, or an injurious action, that he had not committed. (TA.) ―
-b3- And you say, لَا يُتَعَتَّبُ بِشَىْءٍ He is not to be reproved, blamed, or censured, with anything [i. e. with any reproof &c.]. (K, * TA.) And لَا يُتَعَتَّبُ عَلَيْهِ فِى شَىْءٍ [No reproof, blame, or censure, is to be cast upon him in respect of anything]. (ISk, O, TA.) ―
-b4- See also 3. ＝
-A2- تعتّب also signifies He kept to, or was constantly at, the عَتَبَة [or threshold] of the door. (A, TA.) ―
-b2- And you say, تَعَتَّبْتُ بَابَهَ: see 1, latter half.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
